raw: {"analysis":"Response WND provides a more coherent and actionable delivery plan with specific CI optimization strategies, clear rollback protocols, and proper sequencing of the mock IdP stabilization before integration testing. Response KCP contains a critical error in its rollback section, suggesting that if the cookie format was accidentally altered, a user reset would be unavoidable—this directly contradicts the repository facts which state backward compatibility is mandatory and cookie format changes are irreversible without full user reset.
